notes.title: Tenderfoot Tactics + Ice Water Games
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35059002/0e0eb43ea3b73d9a98bf43fc9dbd8d63e3488fa5.png[/img]

Hello!!

We've just announced today that we'll be self-publishing Tenderfoot Tactics through Ice Water Games. This might not seem like a big deal, idk. It's a big deal for us though!

Ice Water Games is a label that most of the Tenderfoot team has been a part of since it was first founded to publish Eidolon. It's a collectively owned and democratically run project, and publishing through it rather than signing with someone else means betting on ourselves and investing in a communally owned resource. IWG's history has been artier and less dorky than Tenderfoot, and by doing this I hope we're both saying: Tenderfoot is arty, actually, in the ways that matter and also, arts outlets should be treating 'lowbrow' fantastical genre work as serious and worth playing.

Probably more exciting, our Steam page has all new screenshots and a fresh gameplay recording with the new UI. Check it out!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1061610/Tenderfoot_Tactics/

notes.title: Tiny Patch
notes.content:
Happy January everyone!

We heard that the quickly flashing day-night cycle that played at startup if you'd been gone a very long time was physically uncomfortable (or even a seizure risk) for some people, so we made a minor graphical adjustment.

Now, if it's been any more than 4 days, while your plants will still grow to reflect it, the time playback animation will only show 4 cycles. 

Love from Seattle!

notes.title: Tenderfoot is a window into another world
notes.content: Take a deep breath — in through the nose, and hold two three, then out through the mouth — and open a window into another world with Tenderfoot [official site]. It’s a small virtual scene staring out a window in a futuristic (and possibly post-apocalyptic?) city. Green creeps up glass-fronted buildings, wind turbines rotate slowly on rooftops, a creature snoozes on a leaf, flocks of birds loop around the city, thick green clouds pass by, and occasionally a putrid sun brightens the mood, all while chill music plays. We can look around a bit, but we’re really there to stare. It’s very pleasant. … [visit site to read more]

notes.title: Build a virtual fire with Eidolon dev s Yule Log
notes.content: On Christmas Eve in 1966, a New York television station broadcast several hours of a festive fireplace so people in fireless flats could tune into The Yule Log and feel Christmassy too. A modern tradition was born. You might have seen fireplace videos in Christmas shops on VHS and DVD, Netflix has three of ’em (I favour the birchwood fire), one ad has Nick Offerman sipping whisky by a fire for 45 minutes, and of course virtual logs exist too. The latest is Yule Log [official site] from Ice Water Games, the makers of Eidolon and Viridi. It lets you watch nice virtual logs burn. Isn’t that enough? … [visit site to read more]

notes.title: Major Summer Solstice Update!
notes.content:
Hi friends!

Sorry for the long silence! We’ve been distracted preparing Viridi for mobile. Now that it’s finally out ([url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.IceWaterGames.Viridi]android[/url] / [url=https://itunes.apple.com/us/app/viridi/id1107708818?mt=8]iOS[/url]), we’re able to bring all of the updates back to our beautiful and faithful Steam community.

Some of the more major changes:
[list][*]New background: the Apartment!
[*]Major visual unification overhaul - new custom shaders, cleaned up textures, lots of visual inconsistencies fixed
[*]Cat House background updated/improved
[*]New diverse snail colorations in different environments
[*]Tab key now cycles through plants
[*]Connection difficulties now reported to user in Nursery
[*]Bug fix: dead/dying plants no longer animate their death on each load
[*]Succulents now grow at a slightly more realistic pace
[*]Succulents are now significantly more resilient
[*]Overwatered succulents return to a Sated state much more quickly
[*]Various flowering issues fixed
[*]Default plant sizes tweaked
[*]Links to various social media and support email added to Nursery
[*]Plant selection/camera tweaked/improved
[*]Improved feedback for Vacation Mode - a Welcome Back screen on return
[*]Lots of bug fixes small and large
[/list]

[img]http://i.imgur.com/HTTrQW5.gif[/img]

notes.title: Sept 13 Update
notes.content:
[list][*]Camera locks more quickly & precisely while placing plants.
[*]Zoom partially enabled while moving plants and snail, for increased precision.
[*]Fixed a bug where backup saves weren't being properly reverted-to in some instances.
[*]Spritz button is now disabled briefly after being pressed, to avoid accidental overwatering-deaths due to doubleclicks/lag.
[*]Spritz/Thirst values tweaked so that spritzing once while Sated will never kill a plant.
[*]New plants now start at the same size as starter plants, instead of automatically starting at the full size their space will allow (to help preserve pot space for easier rearranging).
[*]Confirmation window on plant deletion clarified to exaggerate severity even further.
[*]Flowers now last about a week (and some new flowers added).
[*]Snail freed from trailing-plant prison—now moves freely, incorporally through all biological matter.
[/list]

Keep your pants on - vacation mode (and other common requests) are on their way!

notes.title: Wot I Think (And Wot I Murdered): Viridi
notes.content:
Viridi is a kind of free-to-play desktop potted plant companion. What you get is a pot full of succulents which apparently grow in real time. I have no idea if this is true because I am not good at plants IRL. The developer Ice Water Games (who also made Eidolon) describes it as a “safe haven”, “a place you can return to for a moment of peace and quiet whenever you need it.”

Except I lost my temper and shouted and then aggressively watered a snail.
